name: Morlun
alterEgo: No civilian name in common use
summary: Morlun is an Inheritor who hunts people tied to the spider totem and feeds on their life force. He is a Spider-Man villain, especially in J. Michael Straczynski’s run and the later Spider-Verse comics. He is not a street criminal.
relation: Spider-Man villain. A hunter of spider-totems.
creators: J. Michael Straczynski and John Romita Jr.
powers: Superhuman strength, durability, and the ability to drain the life force of spider-totems.
origin: One of a family of Inheritors. His arrival reframes Spider-Man as prey in a larger hunt.
